_HOW_TO_EDIT: This is the ONE file that holds all the words, links, prices and videos on the website.
1. Change only the text between the quote marks on the right-hand side, e.g. "price": "$49".
2. Keep every quote mark, comma, colon and bracket exactly where it is. If the site stops building, a missing comma is the usual cause (paste this file into jsonlint.com to find it).
3. Anything in [ square brackets ] is a placeholder still waiting for real info from Mehrab.
4. Leave a value as "" (empty) to hide it or fall back to the placeholder, e.g. an empty youtubeId shows a placeholder box.

6. Videos: each project has a thumbnail (public/images/work), a 6-second silent hover preview (public/videos/preview-…), and either videoFile (a short MP4 on this site) or youtubeId / vimeoId for long videos. Paste only the YouTube ID (the part after watch?v= ).
6b. The 3 'Featured work' cards on the Home page are listed in featuredWork: each 'project' must match a project's slug.
5. Videos: for YouTube, paste only the ID (the part after watch?v= ), e.g. "dQw4w9WgXcQ". For Vimeo, paste the number from the link.
7. To switch the accent colour to yellow, change accentColor to "#FFE11A".
8. Save the file. Netlify rebuilds the live site automatically after you upload/push the change.

faq.a: Most videos are delivered within 1–2 days, depending on the video’s length, the amount of raw footage, and the complexity of the project. If you have a specific deadline, let me know in advance so we can discuss the timeline.
Yes, rush delivery may be possible depending on my current workload and the scope of your project. Please confirm your deadline before we begin so I can let you know whether it is feasible.

faq.q: How many revisions can I request?
faq.a: Unlimited revisions are included. I want to make sure the final video aligns with your expectations, so we can work together on adjustments until you’re satisfied, within the agreed project scope. New videos, extra deliverables or changes outside that scope are discussed separately.

faq.q: How do I send my footage?
faq.a: Simply share a link to your footage through Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, or whichever file-sharing service you already use. Make sure the files are accessible so I can download and review them.
Payment can be made through bank transfer or Payoneer. The payment arrangement and project cost will be discussed and agreed upon before the project begins.
I’m based in Bangladesh and work with clients across the US, UK and Europe. Wherever you are, we can discuss your project requirements and deadlines and agree on a timeline that works for you.

faq.q: Do you keep my channel private?
faq.a: Yes. Faceless creators trust me with their channels — I only show work publicly with your permission.
